description: This file contains tests for the channel policy security functions, specifically for creating restricted sender security and warning collectors related to channel configurations. It uses the Vitest testing framework to define test cases and expectations for these functions.

methods.name: createRestrictSendersChannelSecurity
methods.description: Creates security policies restricting who can send messages in channels, with functions to resolve policies from account data.

methods.name: createDangerousNameMatchingMutableAllowlistWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector function for detecting mutable 'allowFrom' entries that match certain dangerous criteria.
